name: list
description:
Which LXC containers on the Proxmox hosts have services running outdated libraries?

For every selected host a table shows the containers, their state (clean / restart / CVEs) and the affected services with CVE verdicts. Rows with work to do deep-link into the **restart** runner with host, container and dry-run pre-filled.

- **Scan now** runs a fresh scan on each host (a few seconds; also warms the hosts' 24h CVE cache). This is the default.
- **Cached** reads the JSON the hosts' 15-minute cron generates (instant, up to 15 minutes old).

parameters.name: Hosts
parameters.description: Proxmox hosts to report on (distro explorer == proxmox).

parameters.name: Data
parameters.description: Fresh scan on the hosts, or read their cached Zabbix JSON.
